name: Lava Country
note: Exterior, recoloured for the lava-flow country (art/lava_tiles.py): basalt ground and levees, dry grass. Same flags as Exterior. E sheet Lava-E (art/lava_e.py): telegraph poles and wires, cairns, a lava-tree mould, rubble, a boulder, lichen, warm cracks, a tumulus.

name: Lava Tubes
note: Interior, recoloured for the lava tubes (art/lava_tiles.py): basalt walls, floors and water banks; gardens stay green, lava stays bright. Same flags as Interior.
